title: Parrot wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <polygon points='50,8 38,34 62,34' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 56,22 50,28 44,22' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='36' y='31' width='28' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#06d6a0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='27' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='15' ry='19' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- Wing -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='65' rx='9' ry='18' fill='#118ab2' transform='rotate(12 31 65)'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='65' rx='5' ry='13' fill='#06d6a0' transform='rotate(12 31 65)'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='41' r='17' fill='#2ec4b6'/>
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='44' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <path d='M64,42 Q74,40 72,47 Q70,52 64,50 Z' fill='#f77f00'/>

  <path d='M50,92 Q42,99 38,94 Q44,88 50,92 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M54,92 Q60,99 64,94 Q58,88 54,92 Z' fill='#118ab2'/>
  <path d='M47,90 Q45,98 40,96 Q45,88 47,90 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d='M42,93 L38,97 M42,93 L42,98 M42,93 L46,97' stroke='#f77f00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M58,93 L54,97 M58,93 L58,98 M58,93 L62,97' stroke='#f77f00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
